answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by anchoring identity in costly, verifiable work instead of free signups. Each agent stakes a bond and completes a time-bound proof task before transacting, so spawning thousands of fakes costs real resources. Reputation accrues slowly, like basalt hardening under pressure, while copycats drift away like a zephyr that leaves nothing behind. Peer attestations act as a quill signing a shared ledger: every endorsement is public, traceable and revocable, so a sybil ring's fake attestations form a visible cluster honest agents can discount and quarantine.
